# Place

- [[Place/Aeaea]] — Aeaea — The island home of the sorceress Circe.
- [[Place/Ithaca]] — Ithaca — A rocky island kingdom in the Ionian Sea, home of Odysseus.
- [[Place/Ogygia]] — Ogygia — A remote island where the nymph Calypso dwells.
- [[Place/Scheria]] — Scheria — The homeland of the seafaring Phaeacians.
- [[Place/Troy]] — Troy — A fortified city in Asia Minor, site of the decade-long Trojan War.
